_note: EN is the first translation target. Keys mirror ru.json exactly. A missing key here falls back to the RU string (i18n.config fallbackLocale), so a partial translation still renders a coherent console. This file is the worked example of 'translate a screen' — the developer extends it screen by screen as pages are keyed.

rotationModal.title: Vault key rotation
rotationModal.warningBeforeCount: The fingerprint is derived from the master key; it cannot be typed in. Rotation re-encrypts
rotationModal.warningAfterCount: : each secret is decrypted with the current key and encrypted again with the new one. A wrong current key means decryption is impossible and secrets are lost.

steps.decrypt: The current key decrypts every secret.
steps.encrypt: Every secret is encrypted again with the new key.
steps.fingerprint: The new fingerprint is derived from the new key; it is not typed.
steps.audit: The old key is destroyed and the operation is written to the log.

rotationModal.ack: I understand that all {count} will be re-encrypted and confirm I have a backup of the current key.
